purpose: Canonical human/agent authoring controls, explicit immutable library and per-instance graphic scope; no executor or authority.

Actual bounded decoder/resource ports and source-clipped provider at C1/C2

sequence: C1 waits stack main acceptance; actual B2 workflow review has priority.
